releases.title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.20
releases.summary: Important: protects playback patches and loads discovery rows sooner.

sections.heading: Important compatibility protection
bullets: Reviewed BlackLanturn patches stay protected during ordinary add-on updates.
Our release notices explain BlackLanturn changes and important compatibility fixes.

sections.heading: Faster discovery rows
bullets: Matching first-page titles appear without waiting to refill every filtered shelf to 20 cards.
Continue along the row to reach further titles. Artwork and watched/progress details remain attached to their original titles.

sections.heading: Your settings and accounts
bullets: Standard update preserves playback choices, selected accounts and the update-notice preference.
Clean installs start with build defaults and a quiet notification baseline.

releases.title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.21
releases.summary: YouTube opens faster with saved rows, current watched status and background refresh.

sections.heading: Faster YouTube browsing
bullets: Previously loaded recommendations, subscriptions and categories can appear immediately after reopening Kodi.
Overdue recommendations refresh in the background. Explicit Refresh remains available.

sections.heading: Current watched status and account privacy
bullets: Reused rows read current watched and resume information instead of freezing old progress in the saved display.
Saved rows belong to the selected account and content preferences. Account or filter changes retire outdated work.

sections.heading: Your settings and playback
bullets: Standard update retains selected settings, playback choices and authorizations. Platform-specific compatibility fixes remain included.
A first load without valid saved rows still needs YouTube and can take several seconds.

releases.title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.23
releases.summary: Important compatibility update: current add-ons with BlackLanturn fixes and safer Standard updates.

sections.heading: Current tested add-ons and patches
bullets: Includes Umbrella 6.7.97 and TMDbHelper 6.18.2 with BlackLanturn playback, progress, cache and privacy fixes.
Current CocoScrapers, Skin Variables, InputStream Helper, InfoTagger and English language resources are included.

sections.heading: Update through BlackLanturn
bullets: Update BlackLanturn Installer, then install this build using Standard. Separate updates of patched add-ons are unnecessary.
Managed versions prevent ordinary upstream updates from silently replacing the patches. Future compatibility fixes arrive in BlackLanturn releases.

sections.heading: Keep your setup
bullets: Standard preserves selected settings and authorizations, local Kodi viewing databases and YouTube watch history. Clean and account-only reset deliberately use build defaults.
Newer compatible ordinary dependencies are kept as complete trees during Standard update. Unknown managed source stops before cleanup.

sections.heading: Playback and platform compatibility
bullets: Existing source selection, Play Next, language/subtitle defaults, automatic YouTube quality and platform-specific workarounds remain included.
Current Helper uses its watched-source setting for watched status and playback progress; the removed separate playback-source default is no longer written.

releases.title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.25
releases.summary: Important update: update bundled add-ons and patches together while keeping your complete Kodi setup.

sections.heading: True in-place update
bullets: Update BlackLanturn Installer, open your build and choose Update BlackLanturn. No reinstall or Save Data choices are needed.
Included add-ons and tested BlackLanturn patches update together. Ordinary upstream updates cannot silently replace managed patches.

sections.heading: Keep your complete setup
bullets: All accounts, playback settings, sources, favourites, watched progress, history and other saved data stay in place.
Other add-ons you installed are left alone. Newer compatible ordinary dependencies are retained as complete trees.

sections.heading: Recovery and compatibility
bullets: The update is checked and staged before replacing code. A failed update rolls back; an interrupted update can recover when you reopen the updater.
Restart Kodi after updating. Fresh and Standard installations remain separate options for setting up a build.

sections.heading: Update reminders
bullets: Available updates return once each Kodi session until installed. Later, Back or timeout means remind me next startup.
Choose Don’t show again for this update to hide that version only. Future releases still notify; completed confirmations appear once.

releases.title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.26
releases.summary: Better title discovery, more reliable previews and easier BlackLanturn updates.

sections.heading: Easier updates
bullets: Installer 1.0.31 adds an Updates sidebar with your installed version, update checks, release notes and notification controls.
Release notes scroll with Up and Down. Update BlackLanturn keeps your complete setup automatically; Keep choices apply to reinstalling.

sections.heading: Better browsing
bullets: Choose genre is available in main Movies and Shows title options, including lower rows. It stays hidden while browsing episodes and other unrelated views.
More like this uses Recommendations first, with Similar as a fallback. Branded Next and Previous retain your title and browsing position.

sections.heading: More reliable previews
bullets: Valid Final Trailer, Red Band Trailer and TV installment labels are recognized while wrong-series checks stay active.
When the usual list has no suitable preview, one limited, cached YouTube lookup can find another. Previews remain excluded from YouTube watch history.

sections.heading: Keep your setup
bullets: Your authorizations, playback settings, watched and resume progress, sources, favourites and other saved data stay in place.
Included add-ons and tested patches update together. Other add-ons you installed are left alone. Close and reopen Kodi after updating.

releases.title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.27
releases.summary: The Installer now updates with the build, keeping your complete setup.

sections.heading: One BlackLanturn update
bullets: The Installer, included add-ons and tested BlackLanturn patches update together.
Once Build 1.1.27 and Installer 1.0.32 are installed, future build updates no longer require a separate Installer update through the repository.

sections.heading: Protected update and recovery
bullets: Updates are staged and checked before replacing code. Interrupted Installer updates can recover when BlackLanturn starts.
Close and reopen Kodi after updating to load the complete new version.
